manualDistinctions.reason: Query intent versus token-prefix grammar versus full-text unique-key, prelimit and relevance repair require different reasoning.
Both-branch eligibility placement, full-text identity/rank repair and earlier-vector post-filter diagnosis are related but not cosmetic copies. 012 still holds for inflated difficulty.
Real-valued RRF summation, either-list inclusion, TOP/window scope and SQL numeric/NULL evaluation are separate facts and failure modes.
Nearest-neighbor overlap differs from labeled relevance recall, first-hit MRR and ordered latency tie-break. 019 is nevertheless simpler and answer-signaled.
Exact function contract, metric/column compatibility, negative-dot geometry and forced-ANN strategy are not interchangeable.
Latest-index two-edit grammar migration does not duplicate aggregation over a globally limited approximate pool.
Component storage sizing, property inspection and norm arithmetic are distinct vector tasks.
